text:
Maya (AE): EmeraldBank just sent a list of docs they want before POC: SOC 2 bridge or report, signed pentest/vuln attestation, KMS/HSM proof, and a firm estimate for dedicated pricing and provisioning. They want it this week.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Quick check: dedicated provisioning for standard reqs is ~10 business days after contract; accelerated options exist but cost extra. I can draft a short timeline and a quoted lead-time cost delta.
Rina (InfoSec): We have a 2025 pen-test summary from RedProbe and a remediation tracker. Customer asked for a signed attestation that a third-party assessment occurred within 12 months. We can produce a one-page attestation with assessor name and dates.
Noah (Legal): We can sign. Need to pin the scope language: external/internal/authenticated. Also prefer to avoid including exploit details. I'll prepare a template.
Sam (CS): On customer scans during POC: standard policy is allowed if they sign the NDA and follow our scan rules. I can produce a POC scan checklist to include with deliverables.
Maya (AE): Their email: 
- SOC 2 Type II or bridge
- Signed pentest/vuln attestation (third-party ok)
- KMS/HSM key custody statement
- Dedicated deployment diagram + timeline
- Dedicated pricing estimate and payment terms
- Permission to run scoped scans during POC
Rina (InfoSec): Note: HSM attestation is sensitive. We can provide a KMS/HSM statement describing model (customer-managed keys supported, HSM-backed providers used) but not internal HSM config. If they need formal attestation, infra team involvement required.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a simplified dedicated-VPC diagram and the provisioning timeline: 
- Day 0: Signed SOW
- Day 1-3: Network prep and SSO/KMS config
- Day 4-10: GPU pool allocation & smoke tests
- Day 11: POC kickoff (estimate)
Maya (AE): Pricing ask: they want a firm dedicated monthly number for 6-month POC. Who can give a ballpark?
Ethan (Solutions Eng): I can give a capacity-based estimate (gpus, memory, region) but pricing owner should confirm. Recommend we provide a range and call out assumptions.
Noah (Legal): I'll review the attestation language once Rina posts a draft. If customer requests notarization or countersigned external verifier, that adds lead time.
AuditBot: Evidence ticket created: https://redwood.internal/audit/requests/EB-2026-028 (owner: Rina, due: 2026-04-05) :memo:
Maya (AE): Action items:
- Rina: draft pentest/va attestation + redacted remediation summary (EOD)
- Ethan: dedicated deployment diagram + provisioning timeline + pricing assumptions (tomorrow)
- Sam: POC scan checklist and allowed tools (today)
- Noah: legal review and sign-off on attestation when posted
- Maya: reply to EmeraldBank requesting NDA signer and confirm their target kickoff date
Sam (CS): I'll also include contact points and throttle limits in the runbook.
Rina (InfoSec): Draft attestation will include assessor (RedProbe), date (2025-09-10), scope (external authenticated + limited manual verification), and remediation status summary.
Maya (AE): OK will send initial reply asking for NDA signee and whether they need SOC2 bridge vs full report. Will upload artifacts to secure share once ready.
Noah (Legal): Quick note: any bespoke language they request on attestations should be escalated.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): I'll post the diagram to the shared drive and link it in the reply.
Maya (AE): Thanks team. I'll update here after I hear back from the customer. :thumbsup:
